service_id.title: Service Id
service_id.description: The identifier of the service to create a conversation starter for.

service_version_set_name.title: Service Version Set Name
service_version_set_name.description: The version set of the service to use. If not provided, the `release` version set is used.

facets.title: Facets
facets.description: The facets that the generated conversation starter should be about. Each generated starter is related to some of these facets.

min_count.title: Min Count
min_count.description: The minimum (inclusive) number of conversation starters to generate.

max_count.title: Max Count
max_count.description: The maximum (inclusive) number of conversation starters to generate.

generation_instructions.description: The instruction for the conversation starter generation.
